name: vibe-ticket-tracker
description: Local ticket tracking system for vibe coding — CLI + Express API with MCP support

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist-server/ dist-ui/ node_modules/ && npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend
scripts.build:server: node frontend/scripts/inject-version.mjs backend && cd backend && npx tsc --project tsconfig.server.json
scripts.build:ui: node frontend/scripts/inject-version.mjs frontend-ts && cd frontend && npx ng build --configuration production && cd .. && node frontend/scripts/inject-version.mjs frontend-html
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui
scripts.prepack: test -d backend/dist && test -d frontend/dist/ui/browser || npm run build; mkdir -p dist-server dist-ui && cp -r backend/dist/* dist-server/ && cp -r frontend/dist/ui/browser/* dist-ui/
scripts.prepublishOnly: test -d backend/dist && test -d frontend/dist/ui/browser || npm run build; mkdir -p dist-server dist-ui && cp -r backend/dist/* dist-server/ && cp -r frontend/dist/ui/browser/* dist-ui/
